title: Overzichtskaart van Java en Madoera – blad IV

series.title: Overzichtskaart van Java en Madoera
series.notes: Maps series of Java and Madura showing residency, plantation and estate boundaries, transportation, water features and populated places. Relief shown by contours, hypsometric tints and spot heights. | Map in Dutch. | Includes lists of estates and plantations and private landed estates, index of adjoining sheets, list of residencies and an administrative division diagram. | Some sheets reproduced in 1940 without full colouring as uncorrected emergency editions: "Ongecorrigeerde spoeddruk 1940"

creator: Topografische Inrichting (Jakarta, Indonesia)
